gaps.explanation: p6 Exhibit 6 Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position - Proprietary Funds prints four enterprise fund columns (Electric Fund, Water Fund, Gas Fund, Sewer Fund) with no schedule lines in detail[] (Internal Service Fund column excluded). JSON statement receipts = Charge for services / Sales + Interest revenue + Miscellaneous / Merchandise Sales. Per fund: Charge for services / Sales 7,644,292 + 1,486,839 + 4,243,608 + 1,176,308 = 14,551,047; Interest revenue 74,190 + 559 + 5,314 + 2,531 = 82,594; Miscellaneous / Merchandise Sales 1,730,747 + 188,599 + 6,672 + (306,457) = 1,619,561 (Sewer printed negative, added negative as the statement line nets it). 14,551,047 + 82,594 + 1,619,561 = 16,253,202 = statement total = gap. Check: 0 + 16,253,202 = 16,253,202.
